note: The florist's: flowers, plants, ferns and bouquets. The wooden post in the middle divides it: feminine nouns on its left, masculine (and the adjectives) on its right. The pots on the front floor are a zoom (R_florist_z1). The left doorway goes back to the hardware shop (1); the right doorway, behind the lady, leads on to the bookshop (2).
